notes: 尖峰 (sharp) applies only to 315千伏安及以上工业用电: the 购电价格 part of the 峰段 price is raised a further 20% (sharp = peak + 0.2 × purchase_price × (1+peak uplift)). Other users bill sharp hours at 峰 (peak); in tariff rows where sharp is NULL, treat 'sharp' segments as 'peak'.

深谷 (deep_valley) applies only to 315千伏安及以上工业用电 on 春节/五一/国庆 holidays (dates per national holiday notice): the 购电价格 part of the 谷段 price is cut a further 20%, 10:00-14:00. Others bill those hours per the normal pattern. 附表2 does not list a 深谷 price.
全体商业用户 and 100千伏安以下工业用户 who opt into TOU may choose the seasonal schedule or the 春秋 schedule all year.
Peak uplift on 购电价格: 两部制 80%, 单一制≥100kVA 70%, 单一制<100kVA 60%; valley discount 65%.
电热锅炉(蓄冰制冷, non-industrial) use a 2-period schedule (平/谷 only) – not stored as a tou_rule.
